title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA - 1997 12.2.5 The age-group and sex-wise distribution of persons arrested under various IPC and SLL cases is given in Table-69. Among the arrested persons, those falling under the age-group of 18-30 years accounted for 52.3 per cent of total persons arrested in IPC and SLL cases. The persons in the age group of 30-50 years shared 40.0 per cent of total persons arrested. The Juveniles arrested accounted for just 0.2 per cent in the total arrests made in the year. Among the Juveniles arrested, girls' share was 19.7 per cent.
